   513→	if len(changes.Modified) == 0 && len(changes.New) == 0 && len(changes.Deleted) == 0 {

   868→// triggerWingmanAutoApplyIfPending checks for a pending REVIEW.md and spawns
   869→// the auto-apply subprocess if conditions are met. Called from the stop hook
   870→// on every turn end (both with-changes and no-changes paths).
   871→//
   872→// When a live session exists, this is a no-op: the prompt-submit injection
   873→// will deliver the review visibly in the user's terminal instead. Background
   874→// auto-apply is only used when no sessions are alive (all ended).
   875→func triggerWingmanAutoApplyIfPending(repoRoot string) {
   876→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "wingman")
   877→	if !settings.IsWingmanEnabled() {
   878→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "wingman auto-apply skip: wingman not enabled")
   879→		return
   880→	}
   881→	if os.Getenv("ENTIRE_WINGMAN_APPLY") != "" {
   882→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "wingman auto-apply skip: already in apply subprocess")
   883→		return
   884→	}
   885→	reviewPath := filepath.Join(repoRoot, wingmanReviewFile)
   886→	if _, statErr := os.Stat(reviewPath); statErr != nil {
   887→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "wingman auto-apply skip: no REVIEW.md pending")
   888→		return
   889→	}
   890→	wingmanState := loadWingmanStateDirect(repoRoot)
   891→	if wingmanState != nil && wingmanState.ApplyAttemptedAt != nil {
   892→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "wingman auto-apply already attempted, skipping",
   893→			slog.Time("attempted_at", *wingmanState.ApplyAttemptedAt),
   894→		)
   895→		return
   896→	}
   897→	// Don't spawn background auto-apply if a live session exists.
   898→	// The prompt-submit hook will inject REVIEW.md as additionalContext,
   899→	// which is visible to the user in their terminal.
   900→	if hasAnyLiveSession(repoRoot) {
   901→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "wingman auto-apply deferred: live session will handle via injection")
   902→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[wingman] Review pending — will be injected on next prompt\n")
   903→		return
   904→	}
   905→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[wingman] Pending review found, spawning auto-apply (no live sessions)\n")
   906→	logging.Info(logCtx, "wingman auto-apply spawning (no live sessions)",
   907→		slog.String("review_path", reviewPath),
   908→	)
   909→	spawnDetachedWingmanApply(repoRoot)
   910→}

   940→// waitForTranscriptFlush polls the transcript file tail for the hook_progress
   941→// sentinel entry that Claude Code writes when launching the stop hook.
   942→// Once this entry appears in the file, all prior entries (assistant replies,
   943→// tool results) are guaranteed to have been flushed.
   944→//
   945→// hookStartTime is the approximate time our process started, used to avoid
   946→// matching stale sentinel entries from previous stop hook invocations.
   947→//
   948→// Falls back silently after a timeout — the transcript copy will proceed
   949→// with whatever data is available.

   417→func acquireWingmanLock(lockPath, sessionID string) bool {

   427→		if statErr != nil || time.Since(info.ModTime()) <= staleLockThreshold {
   428→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[wingman] Review already in progress, skipping\n")
   429→			return false
